title: Female Malfoy Viral Short: Learn Native Romance & Drama English

subtitles.en:
Hello, everyone! Welcome back to the AB
English Podcast. I'm Mia!
subtitles.zh: 大家好！歡迎回到 AB 英文播客，我是 Mia！

subtitles.en:
And I'm Alex... It is so great to see you all
again!
subtitles.zh: 我是 Alex……真的很高興能再次見到大家！

subtitles.en:
Alex, have you seen that viral Female Draco
Malfoy video... the one that completely took
over the internet this month?
subtitles.zh: Alex，你看到這個月在網路上徹底爆紅的女版馬份影片了嗎？

subtitles.en:
Oh, you mean Female Draco Malfoy—also known
as Draconia Malfoy? Wow, it is literally
everywhere on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube
right now!
subtitles.zh:
噢，妳是指女版跩哥馬份——也被稱為跩柯妮亞馬份的那個嗎？
哇，現在 TikTok、Instagram 和 YouTube 上到處
都是她！

subtitles.en:
Yes! If you search Female Draco Malfoy or
Female Malfoy online... millions of people
are totally obsessing over it!
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！只要在網路上搜尋女版馬份……就有好幾百萬人為她徹底瘋狂！

subtitles.en:
Well, the creator is Foyege, and the full
short film is titled The Half-Blood Boy who
Fell for a Pure-Blood Girl.
subtitles.zh:
嗯，創作者是 Foyege，而這部完整短片的片名叫做《愛上純血女孩的混
血男孩》。

subtitles.en:
The cinematography and the lighting... wow,
they look just like a multimillion-dollar
Hollywood blockbuster!
subtitles.zh: 那個運鏡和光影美學……哇，簡直就像耗資數百萬美元的好萊塢大片一樣！

subtitles.en:
And what's truly mind-blowing is that...
well, the characters barely say any lines at
all!
subtitles.zh: 最令人震撼的是……嗯，裡面的角色幾乎完全沒有任何台詞！

subtitles.en:
Exactly! All the romance, the tension, and
the heartbreak... they come purely from
subtle micro-expressions!
subtitles.zh: 真的！所有的愛意、張力與心碎……全都純粹透過細膩的微表情傳遞出來！

subtitles.en:
Exactly. In English storytelling, this is
known as the ultimate art of yearning.
subtitles.zh: 一點也沒錯。在英語敘事中，這被稱為極致的渴望與虐戀之美。

subtitles.en:
Today, we're breaking down this viral Female
Malfoy sensation—and learning the absolute
best English vocabulary for drama, romance,
and cinema!
subtitles.zh:
今天，我們要帶大家深度解析這股爆紅的女版馬份熱潮——並學習聊戲劇、
愛情和電影時最實用的英文詞彙！

subtitles.en:
Plus, we'll share the search keywords and
links so you can easily find and watch this
masterpiece. So... let's dive right in!
subtitles.zh:
此外，我們還會分享搜尋關鍵字與連結，讓大家能輕鬆找到並欣賞這部傑作。
那麼……我們就馬上開始吧！

subtitles.en:
Alex, how should viewers look up these videos
online? What's the official English term to
search for?
subtitles.zh:
Alex，觀眾如果想在網路上找這些影片該怎麼搜尋？
最道地的英文關鍵字是什麼？

subtitles.en:
Well, the top search keyword across all
platforms is Female Draco Malfoy, or
simply... Female Malfoy.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，在各大平台上最熱門的搜尋詞就是女版跩哥馬份，或者乾脆搜女版馬份。

subtitles.en:
Hmm, some fans also search for Draconia
Malfoy or Fem Draco, right?
subtitles.zh: 嗯……有些粉絲也會搜尋跩柯妮亞馬份或是女版跩哥，對吧？

subtitles.en:
That's right! Draconia Malfoy is the creative
name the fan community gave to her character.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！跩柯妮亞馬份就是同人粉絲圈專門為這個角色取的同人名字。

subtitles.en:
And what about that deeply emotional word you
mentioned earlier—yearning?
subtitles.zh: 那你剛才提到的那個充滿情感張力的單字——渴望與思念呢？

subtitles.en:
Yearning means a deep, aching desire... a
painful longing for someone or something you
simply cannot have.
subtitles.zh:
這個詞指的是一種深沉而酸楚的渴望……一種對某個遙不可及、
無法輕易擁有之人刻骨銘心的相思與企盼。

subtitles.en:
Ah... like when they stare at each other
across the Great Hall?
subtitles.zh: 啊……就像他們隔著霍格華茲大廳遙遙相望的那一刻嗎？

subtitles.en:
Precisely. It is completely packed with
romantic tension, sorrow... and quiet hope.
subtitles.zh: 絲毫不差。那種眼神交織著浪漫的張力、悲傷……以及一絲隱密的希望。

subtitles.en:
And the plot follows that classic dynamic...
enemies to lovers, right?
subtitles.zh: 而且這段情節走的是最經典的套路……從死對頭變成戀人，對吧？

subtitles.en:
Oh, yes! Enemies to lovers describes two
bitter rivals who, against all odds,
gradually fall deeply in love with each
other.
subtitles.zh:
噢，沒錯！歡喜冤家變情人描繪的就是兩個勢不兩立的死對頭，
克服重重阻礙、不知不覺墜入愛河的故事。

subtitles.en:
And because their families belong to rival
factions... it becomes a forbidden love.
subtitles.zh: 而且因為兩人的家族陣營對立……這注定是一場禁忌之戀。

subtitles.en:
Definitely! And every single episode ends on
a massive cliffhanger... leaving the audience
practically begging for the next installment!
subtitles.zh:
絕對是！而且每一集都停在最扣人心弦的懸念結尾……讓觀眾心癢難耐，
瘋狂敲碗下一集！

subtitles.en:
Alex, let's walk through some of the most
iconic moments from Part One!
subtitles.zh: Alex，讓我們一起來回顧第一部裡最經典的名場面吧！

subtitles.en:
Well, that opening shot at Platform Nine and
Three-Quarters... it set the perfect mood
right from the start.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，九又四分之三月台的那個開場鏡頭……從一開始就奠定了絕美的基調。

subtitles.en:
The mist rolling through the station... and
just as they brush past one another, she
turns her head and looks back.
subtitles.zh: 瀰漫在車站的霧氣……而在他們擦肩而過的瞬間，她轉過頭深深回望了一眼。

subtitles.en:
Wow... that single glance conveyed
everything—arrogance, curiosity, and secretly
tucked-away tenderness.
subtitles.zh:
哇……那短短的一次回眸道盡了一切——高傲、
好奇，以及小心翼翼隱藏的情愫。

subtitles.en:
And then in the corridor... she purposely
bumps into his shoulder and sends his books
flying everywhere!
subtitles.zh: 然後在走廊上……她還故意撞他的肩膀，把他手裡的書撞得散落一地！

subtitles.en:
Ah, typical tsundere behavior! Acting cold
and harsh on the outside... while secretly
caring on the inside.
subtitles.zh: 哈哈，典型的傲嬌行為！外表裝得冷酷刻薄……內心其實暗暗在乎得要命。

subtitles.en:
But my absolute favorite moment... was during
the magic charms class!
subtitles.zh: 但我最喜歡的一幕……絕對是魔法課上的那個瞬間！

subtitles.en:
You mean... when she gently blows that
glowing paper crane toward Harry?
subtitles.zh: 妳是說……當她輕輕吹動那隻發光的魔法紙鶴、讓它飛向哈利的時候嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes! The paper crane glows with this soft
light, Harry unfolds it... and looks right
across the room into her eyes!
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！紙鶴散發著柔和的微光，哈利將它拆開……然後抬頭直直看進她的雙眼！

subtitles.en:
Oh, the lighting and the subtle sparkle in
their eyes... that frame was pure cinematic
perfection.
subtitles.zh: 噢，那一幕的光影與眼神中的微光流轉……完全是殿堂級的電影美學。

subtitles.en:
And then—the dramatic climax... the Quidditch
match!
subtitles.zh: 接著——就是全片最高潮的轉折……魁地奇比賽！

subtitles.en:
She loses her grip on the broomstick... slips
off, and plummets straight down through the
open sky!
subtitles.zh: 她失去了對飛天掃帚的控制……滑落下來，整個人朝著地面急墜而下！

subtitles.en:
And just seconds before she crashes... Harry
swoops down on his broom and catches her
right out of the air!
subtitles.zh: 就在她快要墜毀的前一秒……哈利騎著掃帚俯衝而下，在半空中一把接住了她！

subtitles.en:
And then—freeze frame on their expressions,
followed by those agonizing words: To Be
Continued!
subtitles.zh:
然後——畫面瞬間定格在他們的表情上，浮現出那行讓人抓狂的字句：未完待續
！

subtitles.en:
Oh, when Part One wrapped up, millions of
frantic fans flooded the comments,
practically screaming for Part Two!
subtitles.zh:
哈哈，第一部一播完，幾百萬名激動的粉絲立刻湧入留言區，
瘋狂吶喊求更第二部！

subtitles.en:
And Part Two took all that drama, heartbreak,
and emotional intensity to a whole new level!
subtitles.zh: 而第二部更是把所有的戲劇衝突、虐戀心碎與情感張力推向了全新巔峰！

subtitles.en:
Oh... the Quidditch World Cup campsite
scene—it completely broke my heart!
subtitles.zh: 唉……魁地奇世界盃營地的那場戲——真的讓我心碎不已！

subtitles.en:
She runs straight into the burning forest to
find Harry... defying her own father!
subtitles.zh: 她直接衝進燃燒的森林尋找哈利……完全違抗了自己父親的命令！

subtitles.en:
She shields his unconscious body with her
own! But... oh, what happened next?
subtitles.zh: 她竟然用自己的身體護住昏迷的他！但是……天啊，接下來發生了什麼事？

subtitles.en:
Harry slowly wakes up... and instead of her
name, he murmurs another girl's name!
subtitles.zh:
哈利慢慢甦醒過來……但嘴裡含糊喊出的，不是她的名字，
而是另一個女孩的名字！

subtitles.en:
Wow... her heartbroken expression in that
scene was pure acting mastery!
subtitles.zh: 哇……那一幕她心碎的神情，簡直是演技的神級發揮！

subtitles.en:
The caption read... 'Why is the name on your
lips... not mine?'
subtitles.zh: 字幕上面寫著……「為什麼你嘴裡喊出的名字……不是我？」

subtitles.en: Oh, it is so painful... but so, so good!
subtitles.zh: 喔，這真的太虐心了……但又好看得不得了！

subtitles.en:
By the way, everyone—if you haven't seen this
masterpiece yet, you definitely should!
subtitles.zh: 順便提醒大家——如果你們還沒看過這部神作，絕對要去看看！

subtitles.en:
Yes! We've put the direct link to the full
video... right down in our description box
below.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！我們已經把完整影片的直接連結……放在下方說明欄裡面了。

subtitles.en:
Well, you can also search Female Draco Malfoy
or Foyege on YouTube and TikTok... to find
all the parts!
subtitles.zh:
嗯，大家也可以在 YouTube 和 TikTok 搜尋 Female
Draco Malfoy 或是 Foyege……就能找到所有的片段！

subtitles.en:
Definitely click the link after this episode
and watch it for yourself! I mean... the
visuals will give you goosebumps!
subtitles.zh:
聽完這集之後一定要點開連結親自觀看！我是說……那些視覺畫面真的會讓你起
雞皮疙瘩！

subtitles.en:
What makes this even crazier... is that it
was made by a single solo creator named
Foyege!
subtitles.zh:
讓這件事更驚人的是……這竟然全是由一位名叫 Foyege 的獨立創作者
獨自完成的！

subtitles.en:
Wow... just one person and an AI video model!
No huge film crew, no Hollywood studio!
subtitles.zh:
哇……僅憑一個人加上 AI 影片模型！沒有龐大的拍攝團隊，
也沒有好萊塢製片廠！

subtitles.en:
Exactly. It shows how AI is democratizing
high-end cinema... for creators all around
the world.
subtitles.zh:
沒錯。這展現了 AI 正在將高端電影製作平民化……讓全世界的創作者都能
拍出大片。

subtitles.en:
Hmm, Alex... why do you think audiences
across different countries love this Female
Malfoy character so much?
subtitles.zh:
嗯……Alex，你覺得為什麼不同國家的觀眾會這麼喜歡這個女版馬份的角色
？

subtitles.en:
Because great storytelling relies on
universal emotions... not just flashy special
effects.
subtitles.zh: 因為優秀的敘事靠的是人類共通的情感……而不僅僅是華麗的特效。

subtitles.en:
Oh... you mean the intense contrast between
duty and desire?
subtitles.zh: 喔……你是說家族責任與內心渴望之間的強烈對比嗎？

subtitles.en:
Exactly! In English literature, that's the
core of classic tragedy... like Romeo and
Juliet.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！在英國文學中，這正是像羅密歐與茱麗葉這類經典悲劇的核心。

subtitles.en:
A pure-blood girl and a half-blood boy...
divided by war, but bound by love.
subtitles.zh: 一個純血統女孩和一個混血男孩……被戰爭撕裂，卻被愛緊緊繫在一起。

subtitles.en:
And notice how the creator used lighting...
to express their inner feelings!
subtitles.zh: 而且注意看創作者是如何運用光影……來表達他們內心情感的！

subtitles.en:
Yes! Cool blue tones for Slytherin... and
warm amber tones for Gryffindor!
subtitles.zh: 對！史萊哲林用的是清冷的藍調……而葛萊分多則融入了溫暖的琥珀色調！

subtitles.en:
When those two colors blend together... it
symbolizes their colliding worlds.
subtitles.zh: 當這兩種色彩交融在一起時……正象徵著他們彼此碰撞的命運世界。

subtitles.en:
Ah, that is so poetic! I love how much depth
a simple AI video can actually have.
subtitles.zh:
啊，這真的太有詩意了！我真的很驚訝一部簡單的 AI 影片竟然能擁有這麼
深沉的情感厚度。

subtitles.en:
Well, this is precisely why English learners
should watch films and fan edits like this.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，這正是為什麼學習英文的人應該多看這類的電影與粉絲剪輯影片。

subtitles.en:
Right! You learn real cultural idioms,
storytelling terms... and emotional
vocabulary!
subtitles.zh: 對啊！你能學到道地的文化諺語、影視敘事用語……還有豐富的表達情感詞彙！

subtitles.en:
Exactly! And it makes language learning
exciting... instead of just boring
memorization.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！這會讓語言學習變得非常刺激有趣……再也不是死板枯燥的背單字。

subtitles.en:
Now, let's do our absolute favorite part...
speaking practice!
subtitles.zh: 現在，來到我們最喜歡的環節……口說跟讀練習！

subtitles.en:
Repeat after Mia with passion and confidence!
Sentence number one: Search Female Draco
Malfoy to find the video.
subtitles.zh:
帶著熱情與自信跟著 Mia 一起開口唸！第一句：搜尋 Female D
raco Malfoy 就能找到影片。

subtitles.en:
Search Female Draco Malfoy... to find the
video.
subtitles.zh: 搜尋 Female Draco Malfoy 就能找到這支影片。

subtitles.en:
Awesome! Sentence number two: I love the
enemies-to-lovers trope.
subtitles.zh: 太棒了！第二句：我超愛死對頭變情侶的故事設定。

subtitles.en: I love... the enemies-to-lovers trope.
subtitles.zh: 我超愛歡喜冤家變戀人的故事設定。

subtitles.en:
Sentence number three: That scene was filled
with pure yearning.
subtitles.zh: 第三句：那場戲充滿了極致深沉的渴望。

subtitles.en: That scene was filled with pure yearning.
subtitles.zh: 那場戲充滿了極致深沉的思念與渴望。

subtitles.en:
And sentence number four: Be sure to check
out the video link in the description!
subtitles.zh: 第四句實用神句：一定要去看看說明欄裡的影片連結！

subtitles.en:
Be sure to check out the video link in the
description!
subtitles.zh: 一定要去看看說明欄裡的影片連結喔！

subtitles.en:
Fantastic job, everyone! Your pronunciation
is getting more natural... every single day.
subtitles.zh: 太出色了，大家！你們的發音一天比一天更自然、更道地了。

subtitles.en:
Wow, today's episode was so inspiring! The
future of creative storytelling... is right
here!
subtitles.zh:
哇，今天的節目真的太啟發人心了！創意影視敘事的未來……真的就在我們眼前
！

subtitles.en:
Absolutely. Whether it's cinema, books, or
learning English... it's all about connecting
with people.
subtitles.zh: 確實如此。無論是電影、書籍還是學習英文……核心都在於與人建立情感連結。

subtitles.en:
Don't forget—if you want to watch the
original viral video, the link is right below
in our description!
subtitles.zh: 別忘了——如果你想觀看這部爆紅的原始短片，連結就在下方的說明欄裡喔！

subtitles.en:
You can also search Female Draco Malfoy or
Draconia Malfoy... to explore the entire
community!
subtitles.zh:
大家也可以搜尋 Female Draco Malfoy 或 Draco
nia Malfoy……去探索整個熱門社群的精彩作品！

subtitles.en:
And to practice speaking just like a
native... be sure to check out our free tools
over at GugoPro!
subtitles.zh:
想要練習說出一口道地的母語，請務必使用我們在 GugoPro 上提供的
免費工具！

subtitles.en:
You can use the free L-Player for some line-
by-line shadowing... or hey, why not have a
real-time voice chat with our AI speaking
tutor?
subtitles.zh:
你可以使用免費的 L-Player 進行逐句跟讀，
或者也可以直接與我們的 AI 口說家教進行語音對話。

subtitles.en:
Both of these tools are completely free... no
downloads, no registration required at all.
You can find all the links right there in the
description!
subtitles.zh: 這兩款工具完全免費，不需要下載也不用註冊。相關連結都放在說明欄裡了！

subtitles.en:
If you truly enjoyed today's story, please
give us a thumbs up... and make sure to
subscribe to the AB English Podcast!
subtitles.zh:
如果你喜歡今天的故事，請幫我們點個讚，並訂閱 AB English P
odcast！

subtitles.en:
Oh, and don't forget to hit that notification
bell... so you never miss another fun and
insightful episode!
subtitles.zh: 記得按下訂閱鈴鐺，這樣你就絕對不會錯過任何精彩又有深度的節目了！

subtitles.en:
Thank you so, so much for listening today...
we really appreciate it. We will see you all
next time!
subtitles.zh: 非常感謝大家的收聽，我們下次見！

subtitles.en: Bye everyone!
subtitles.zh: 大家掰掰！
